g.text: Medians with Q1-Q3 spread; 10 fresh processes per cell.
Each time includes startup, parsing, export and exit.
Panel scales differ; all start at zero.
M1 Pro (10 cores), 32 GiB RAM, macOS 27.0, AC power.
Current uncommitted optimization; one descriptive session.
Same learning content; default APKG formats differ.
All 840 exports validated; 40 Anki import/render checks.
RSS was measured in 5 separate processes per cell.
Raw data and full resource tables accompany this figure.
